name: Simplified Checkout — Sales Funnel & One-Click Upsells
author: BeSimplified Team

sections.description:
Simplified Checkout is a WordPress/WooCommerce plugin that integrates advanced features in your checkout to enhance the experience for your customers and increase your sales potential. With Simplified Checkout, you can process transactions through a supported CRM, process subscription-type orders, and set up member portals so your customers can manage their orders and subscriptions.

This plugin connects directly to Simplified Checkout and allows you to set up 1-click upsells, sync between your CRM and WooCommerce, 1-page checkouts, and much more. A full list of the features can be found below. Learn more about Simplified Checkout

Built-In Features

• Connect with our supported CRMs*
• Support for more payment processors and payment options (PayPal, Apple Pay & Google Pay)
• Support for subscriptions & one-time purchases
• Powerful custom checkout builder
• Create 1-click upsells, downsells, and cross-sells
• Simple tracking pixel integration
• Enhanced security with bot and malware detection and prevention
• Fraud detection and prevention
• Coupon management
• Abandoned cart recovery
• Built-in split testing
• Built-in member/customer portals
• Checkout reports and analytics
• Support for direct checkout links
• and much, much more!

*Supported CRMs

• CheckoutChamp
• Vrio CRM
• Sticky.io
• Konnektive CRM

If you are interested in Simplified Checkout, sign up and get started with us today!

External Services

This plugin connects to external services provided by Simplified Checkout to enable advanced checkout functionality. Below is detailed information about each service, what data is transmitted, and when these connections occur.

Important Notice: This plugin requires communication with external servers to function properly. By using this plugin, you acknowledge that data will be transmitted to third-party services as described below.

Service Provider: Simplified Checkout (BeSimplified)
Company Website: https://www.besimplified.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.besimplified.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.besimplified.com/terms-of-service/

1. Simplified Checkout [API](api.checkout.besimplified.com)

Core API for checkout processing, order management, and CRM sync. Sends store URL, WooCommerce keys, license key, order and cart data during activation, checkout, and reporting.

2. [Simplified Checkout Admin](checkout.besimplified.com)

Admin interface for checkout configuration. Sends store URL, WooCommerce keys, and basic store config during setup and when using the checkout builder.

3. [Simplified Accounts](accounts.besimplified.com)

Authentication and account management. Sends user credentials, auth tokens, and license details during login and feature access.

All transmission occurs over HTTPS. Deactivating the plugin stops all external communication. For data requests or questions, contact support@besimplified.com.

Permissions

  • Admin capabilities required: Users must have the manage_options capability to:
    • Access the Simplified Checkout settings page
    • Enable or disable Live mode
    • Re-check connection status from the admin screen

Third-party Libraries

Bootstrap (v5.0.2 JS / v5.1.3 CSS) — MIT License. Source: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
Font Awesome (v6.7.2) — Icons CC BY 4.0, Fonts SIL OFL 1.1, Code MIT. Source: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome
Roboto (Google Fonts) — Apache License 2.0. Source: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simplified-checkout-upsells folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Simplified Checkout” menu to configure the plugin.
